bug.short_desc: Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied

long_desc.thetext:
Created attachment 77631 notepad++ has menu bar in light mode
Notepad++ 8.7.1 dark mode is not fully applied, because the menu bar remains in light mode
Created attachment 77632 how it should look
To reproduce, download notepad++ 8.7.1, then go to settings, preferences, dark mode then enable dark mode.
